subject: Maths
pacing_note: The IEB publishes no ATP equivalent; term placement and week spans are the DBE ATP pacing carried over as a default. IEB schools set their own pacing — treat weeks as advisory.
assessment_note: DBE SBA programmes, control-test scopes and exam structures are deliberately stripped: IEB assessment is specified by the IEB Subject Assessment Guidelines (see ../exam_guidelines/), which have not been ingested yet. Do not fall back to the CAPS exam_structure for IEB papers.

topics.name: Exponents and surds
subtopics: Laws of exponents for rational exponents x^(p/q) = qth root of x^p (x>0, q>0); simplify and solve equations
Add, subtract, multiply and divide simple surds
Solve simple equations involving surds

topics.name: Equations and inequalities
subtopics: Complete the square
Solve quadratic equations by factorisation and by the quadratic formula
Quadratic inequalities in one unknown (interpret solutions graphically)
Equations in two unknowns: one linear, one quadratic
Nature of roots

topics.name: Trigonometry (reduction formulae, trig equations & general solutions)
subtopics: Derive and use identities tanθ = sinθ/cosθ and sin²θ + cos²θ = 1
Derive and use reduction formulae: (90°±θ), (180°±θ), (360°±θ), (−θ)
Determine for which values of a variable an identity holds
General solutions of trigonometric equations; solutions in specific intervals

topics.name: Euclidean Geometry
subtopics: Accept as axiom: a tangent to a circle is perpendicular to the radius at the point of contact
Prove circle theorems: line from centre perpendicular to chord bisects it; line from centre to chord midpoint is perpendicular; perpendicular bisector of a chord passes through the centre
Prove: angle at centre is double the angle at the circumference; angles subtended by a chord on the same side are equal; opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral are supplementary
Prove: two tangents from the same external point are equal; tangent-chord angle equals the angle in the alternate segment
Use the theorems and their converses to solve riders

topics.name: Analytical Geometry
subtopics: Revise distance, gradient (parallel and perpendicular lines) and midpoint
Equation of a line through two points; through one point parallel or perpendicular to a given line
Inclination of a line, m = tanθ (0° ≤ θ ≤ 180°)

topics.name: Functions (including trigonometric functions)
subtopics: Effect of parameters a, q and p on y=a(x+p)²+q, y=a/(x+p)+q, y=a·b^(x+p)+q (b>0, b≠1)
Average gradient between two points; intuitive gradient of a curve at a point
Point-by-point plotting of y=sinθ, y=cosθ, y=tanθ for θ∈[−360°,360°]
Effect of k on y=sin(kx), y=cos(kx), y=tan(kx)
Effect of p on y=sin(x+p), y=cos(x+p), y=tan(x+p)
Sketch y=a·sin k(x+p), y=a·cos k(x+p), y=a·tan k(x+p) (at most two parameters at a time)

topics.name: Trigonometry (sine, cosine and area rules)
subtopics: Prove and apply the sine, cosine and area rules
Solve problems in two dimensions using the sine, cosine and area rules

topics.name: Statistics
subtopics: Revise measures of central tendency and dispersion (ungrouped and grouped data)
Revise five number summary and box-and-whisker diagram
Revise histograms
Frequency polygons
Ogives (cumulative frequency curves)
Variance and standard deviation of ungrouped data
Symmetric and skewed data
Identification of outliers

topics.name: Probability
subtopics: Revise probability models: relative frequency vs theoretical probability
Venn diagrams; addition rule; mutually exclusive and complementary events
Dependent and independent events; product rule for independent events
Venn diagrams for any three events in a sample space
Tree diagrams for consecutive or simultaneous events (not necessarily independent)
Venn diagrams, tree diagrams and contingency tables for real-life problems

topics.name: Finance, growth and decay
subtopics: Revise simple and compound growth formulae (interest, hire purchase, inflation, population growth)
Implications of fluctuating foreign exchange rates
Simple and compound decay formulae A=P(1−in), A=P(1−i)ⁿ (straight-line and reducing-balance depreciation)
Different periods of compounding; nominal and effective interest rates

topics.name: Number patterns
subtopics: Investigate quadratic number patterns (constant second difference); general term

topics.name: Revision of measurement
subtopics: Volume and surface area of right prisms and cylinders
Effect on volume and surface area of multiplying any dimension by a constant factor k
Volume and surface area of spheres, right prisms, right cones and combinations
